items.text: Backlink monitoring is the process of regularly tracking and analyzing the links pointing to your website from other sites. It involves checking whether your existing backlinks are still active, identifying new backlinks as they appear, and analyzing the quality and relevance of those links. Effective backlink monitoring helps you maintain a healthy link profile, identify potentially harmful links, and find opportunities for new link building. Common tools for backlink monitoring include Ahrefs, Semrush, and Moz, which provide comprehensive dashboards for tracking your link profile over time.
